description: Learn what a business's Foundry ontology holds before you ask or read it: its schema (each type's properties, key, names and identifiers, and its links, rules and constraints) and example questions it answers, the ones Foundry suggests. It describes the version of the current load, which helix_foundry_ask and helix_foundry_read_graph use by default, or the current version while nothing is loaded. An agent bundle's schema is its ontology.toml; a Definition v1 version's is its definition. With source grants that cover part of the load, it describes that part.

workspace_id.description: Helix workspace identifier. May be empty when the caller has only one workspace (a service key always does).

name: helix_foundry_get_context

definition.description: Untrusted. A Definition v1 version's schema: its entities, relationships, rules and constraints.

example_questions.description: Untrusted. Up to 4 questions the version was drafted to answer, the ones Foundry suggests: good first questions for helix_foundry_ask. Empty for a Definition v1 version, a draft without them, and a caller whose source grants cover only part of the load.

ontology_toml.description: Untrusted. An agent bundle's schema, its ontology.toml: [types.<Type>] with description, props (name = type), key, names and identifiers; [links.<name>] with from, to, description, cardinality and required; [rules.<name>] and [constraints.<name>] with description, severity and datalog. Types and links are the ones ask and read_graph name.

version.description: The version described: the current load's, else the current version while nothing is loaded. Absent while the ontology has no version, or when the caller's source grants cover no load.

definition.description: Untrusted ontology definition, in the shape format names. An agent bundle's questions are the draft's open questions: a question's default is the agent's suggestion, not a decision, so read what the draft does from its files and document_reads. Its left_out lists what the draft left out of the sources it was given, each {what, reason} and, when the agent said, because (helix_foundry_get_version gives its three shapes): what starts with a source's id, then names the field when it is one. A synced table's id is src_ and 16 hex digits, and its entry also has connector_id and table (the version's tables lists every one); a table file's is its document id, which helix_foundry_list_documents names; a document set's is the set's id, which helix_foundry_get_ontology names.

tables.description: The synced tables its generation drafted from, each with the id (source_id, src_ and 16 hex digits) its definition names the table by, in mappings_toml and at the start of a left_out entry. Only helix_foundry_get_version returns it; absent for a version no generation drafted, one drafted from no synced table, and a caller who can't read its generation.

title: Get an ontology's schema and example questions
